notes.title: 3/29更新说明：游戏全面汉化更新 —— 日记部分现已全新汉化！
notes.content:
亲爱的玩家们，

我们非常高兴地宣布，最新更新中，游戏的所有日记内容现已全面汉化！在此次更新中，我们对日记部分进行了深入本地化处理，确保所有文本、图片和交互均支持中文显示，为广大中文玩家带来更流畅、更贴近本土文化的游戏体验。

此次更新亮点包括：
• 日记内容全汉化：日记内容全部已转换为简体中文，让故事情节更易理解。
• 汉化图片优化：我们重新设计了部分图片，使其在中文模式下呈现最佳效果。
• 全面细节调整：对 UI 界面、提示文字和互动反馈进行了优化，确保整体体验更加顺畅自然。

我们衷心感谢大家一直以来的支持与反馈！希望这次更新能为您带来全新的体验。如果您在游戏过程中遇到任何问题或有更多建议，欢迎随时与我们联系。

Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that our latest update has fully localized the diary section into Chinese! In this update, we have meticulously translated all diary text, images, and interactions to ensure a completely localized experience for our Chinese-speaking community.

What's New:

[list]
[*] Fully Translated Diary Content: All diary entries are now presented in Simplified Chinese for a clearer and more immersive experience.
[*] Optimized Chinese Images: We have redesigned key diary images to ensure they display beautifully in Chinese mode.
[*] Comprehensive UI Adjustments: UI elements, prompts, and interactive feedback have been fine-tuned to enhance overall usability and cultural relevance.
[/list]

We sincerely appreciate your continued support and feedback. We hope you enjoy the enhanced experience, and as always, feel free to reach out with any suggestions or issues.

Happy gaming!

notes.title: 3/15 Update
notes.content:
We have added Chinese translations for the game UI! ✨ You can now switch to the Chinese interface in the main menu for a smoother experience.
Additionally, the diary section is expected to be fully localized next week, so stay tuned! Thank you for your patience and support! ❤️
